stemMd: A box holds €1 and €2 coins, 18 coins in total, worth €29. How many €2 coins are there?
explanationMd: If all eighteen coins were €1, the value would be €18. The extra €11 comes from replacing eleven of them with €2 coins, each adding one euro. Thus there are eleven €2 coins and seven €1 coins.

distractorRationale.a: This is the number of €1 coins.
distractorRationale.d: This would give a total of €32.
